retrievalProfile.description: A centered circular needlepoint emblem of a heraldic eagle set against a flat, vibrant blue background with structured vintage typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular gold frame containing a hand-stitched needlepoint depiction of a heraldic eagle with a shield, olive branch, and arrows, floating on a solid cerulean blue field with white serif text contained in a pill-shaped border at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular central focus against a square field
Tactile textile texture contrasted with flat graphic background
Primary color palette of blue, gold, and red
coreInvariants: Needlepoint/embroidery texture for the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The needlepoint circle is centrally located, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The embroidered eagle's red and white striped shield.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central emblem, move up to the framed title text, then down to the secondary title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat blue space surrounds the central circular element.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold frame and red/blue embroidery threads
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with medium-value, naturally textured subject matter.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized with a large lower loop

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a white pill-shaped outline

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching the display serif with a wider, more geometric sans-serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Circular gold frame with concentric ridges

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif structure and classic feel.
Provides the elegant, traditional Americana look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat cerulean blue background. In the center, place a circular gold frame containing a needlepoint embroidery of a heraldic eagle on a cream canvas background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white pill-shaped outline at the top. Inside the outline, place two lines of white, high-contrast serif text in all caps. Add a secondary line of wider sans-serif text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the eagle clearly rendered as embroidery/needlepoint?
Is the background a solid, untextured blue?
Is the top text enclosed in a pill-shaped border?

adjustableVariables: Frame material (e.g., wood instead of gold)

mustAchieve: Visible thread texture in the central emblem

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the needlepoint texture is distinct from a flat illustration.
Ensure the gold frame has a metallic, dimensional appearance.
Verify the pill-shaped border at the top is a clean white line.
Check that the blue background is perfectly uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject: Needlepoint Emblem] + [Frame: Circular Gold] + [Background: Solid Cerulean Blue] + [Header: Pill-bordered Serif Typography]
